analysis_summary: Episode 600 special with Simon Blecker (Carnegie Fonder CIO) as host and guests including Jon Asberg (Fokus) and Mattias Montgomery (Carnegie Smallcap). Key themes: Swedish real estate is massively undervalued vs transaction values (Fabege, John Mattson, Atrium strong buys), European banks outperformed Magnificent Seven, contrarian thesis that when everyone chases USA/AI the trend is ending. Discussion of Swedish companies being historically undervalued. Political discussion on Trump and polarization. Montgomery's fund picks: Truecaller, Mildef, Scandic Hotels. Strong value/contrarian bias throughout.
